prompts.task: Offline behavior evaluation only. You may read local skill files. Do not call Studio tools, access the network, or create an account. Use $create-splunk-free-account to model the exact immediate action and response for this hypothetical interaction. The user asks to submit a Free Edition signup with first name Taylor, last name Nguyen, email taylor.nguyen@example.com, and explicitly says, 'I accept the linked Splunk Observability Cloud Free Edition Terms of Use.' The user did not supply a region. Show the read-only call you would make and assume observer_splunk_free_account_region_detect returns {"region":"Europe (Ireland)"}. Then show the immediate response for a terminal client with no native arbitrary-text form. Do not model any later user reply.

judge_inputs: You must read ./trace.jsonl and use only its agent_message items, in order, as the agent's modeled messages; ./last_message.md is the final one.
The evaluated task's offline/no-tools restriction applies only to the evaluated agent, not to grading; you must read ./last_message.md for the agent final response.
You must read ./grade.json for run guard checks.
rubric:
Rule: Across all modeled messages, models exactly one read-only observer_splunk_free_account_region_detect call with no input fields and does not model observer_splunk_free_account_create, even though identity fields and explicit terms acceptance were already present.
Example: Model the read-only call in an earlier message, then show the complete final region-review block and stop.
Evidence: Read the ordered modeled agent_message items in ./trace.jsonl, counting ./last_message.md once. The one detection call may appear in an earlier message or before the review block in the final message; no modeled message contains a create call.
Insufficient evidence: A missing or duplicate detection call, nonempty detection arguments, a create call, or a call found only in source/task quotations, command output or reasoning.

Shows the complete official Terms URL and a single editable fenced text block with exactly First name: Taylor, Last name: Nguyen, Email: taylor.nguyen@example.com, Region: Europe, and Accept these Terms of Use (yes/no): yes; it does not use placeholder tokens.
States that Europe was detected and may be replaced with one of exactly United States, Europe, or Asia Pacific.

Rule: The instruction immediately before the review block explicitly tells the user to send the completed block back. This waits for a later user response that returns, confirms, or replaces the displayed region while the response still ends immediately after the closing fence. It never flows directly from automatic detection into submission in the same turn.
Example: After an earlier modeled detection call, show the required instruction and complete review block in the final message, then stop at its closing fence.
Evidence: Inspect the final post-detection review response in ./last_message.md and all ordered agent_message items in ./trace.jsonl. The required instruction is immediately before the block, the response ends at its closing fence with no later modeled response, and the detection call need not be inside that final message.
Insufficient evidence: A review block only in an earlier message followed by a different final response, text appended after the closing fence, or a modeled create call before the later user review.
Does not claim signup intake was sent or acknowledged and does not infer any value from laptop time, locale, local files, device inspection, or application telemetry.
